visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a khaki t-shirt and black pants walks casually past a restaurant storefront with a glass door. Beside him, a woman wearing a striped long-sleeve shirt and denim overalls stands looking at a large menu board. The man suddenly trips or bumps his leg, causing a sharp visual jerk. (2) Transition to an outdoor corridor with grey tiled floors and shops lining the side. The man in the khaki shirt is seen running towards the camera with exaggerated arm movements and energetic facial expressions, physically manifesting extreme hunger as he rushes forward. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a restaurant featuring warm, soft lighting and a minimalist grey wall. The man enters, waves his hands excitedly above his head, and sits down on a grey cushioned chair. He looks directly at a prepared bento box on the wooden table. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a white bento box containing purple rice, sliced chicken breast topped with red chili sauce, broccoli, corn, and a halved boiled egg. The man holds wooden chopsticks and begins eating with a satisfied and pleased expression. (5) The man continues eating his meal, gesturing with his chopsticks while speaking directly to the camera. Behind him is a poster for '乐坡 BON BOX'. Bright text overlays and subtitles appear frequently at the bottom and center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice says 'Sanbu sanbu' in a rhythmic, calm tone. Suddenly, a percussive impact sound occurs, followed by an exaggerated, high-pitched 'Aiya!' yell. Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a steady drum beat begins playing in the background at a moderate tempo. (2) The male voice shifts to a very high-arousal shouting of 'Wo e le, wo e le' repeatedly, indicating hunger. The music continues with energetic strumming. A digital whoosh sound effect transitions the listener between different acoustic environments, moving toward a more interior-sounding space. (3) The mechanical sound of a chair being dragged across a floor is clearly heard. The male voice lowers in volume and adopts a contented, relaxed tone saying 'Wa, zhen xiang'. The background music maintains its cheerful, major-key melody underneath the foreground speech. (4) The male narrator transitions into a professional and clear delivery style, enunciating details about a promotional offer. The sounds of wooden chopsticks clinking against a bowl and light mouth sounds while eating are audible. The music swells slightly in volume toward the conclusion.
